title: SkillChain: Closing the Loop on Skill Evolution for Image-Based E-Commerce AI Assistants
title_zh: SkillChain：为图像电商 AI 助手闭环优化技能演化
abstract_en: Image-based AI assistants are now deployed at production scale on e-commerce platforms, where a single uploaded image can trigger fundamentally different user intents: product search, style recommendation, visual encyclopedia, or utility tool calls, each demanding its own response format, tool invocation, and domain knowledge. Without per-intent behavioral constraints, LLM-based systems conflate these heterogeneous modes and fall short of domain quality standards, while the breadth and dynamism of the intent space render manual engineering infeasible. To address this, we present SkillChain, which closes the production feedback loop on Skill evolution, automating the lifecycle of Skills through three stages: Skill Creator for bootstrapping from task specs and trajectories, Route Optimizer for routing alignment, and Body Refiner for iterative Skill Body refinement via dual-path LLM-Judge evaluation. Deployed on a production-scale e-commerce image assistant, SkillChain substantially improves aggregate response quality, with the strongest gains on structural compliance and content quality; a one-week online A/B experiment further confirms significant gains in user engagement, content consumption, and long-term retention.
abstract_zh: 本文面向生产级电商平台中的图像 AI 助手问题：同一张用户上传图片可能对应商品搜索、风格推荐、视觉百科或工具调用等不同意图，每类意图都需要特定的回复格式、工具调用方式和领域知识。若缺少按意图划分的行为约束，基于 LLM 的系统容易混淆不同任务模式，难以满足电商场景的质量要求；而意图空间庞大且持续变化，纯人工规则工程不可扩展。为此，论文提出 SkillChain，通过生产反馈闭环自动化 Skill 的生命周期，包括三个阶段：Skill Creator 根据任务规范和轨迹初始化 Skill，Route Optimizer 优化意图到 Skill 的路由对齐，Body Refiner 借助双路径 LLM-Judge 评估迭代改进 Skill Body。该方法已部署在生产级电商图像助手中，显著提升整体响应质量，尤其在结构合规性和内容质量上收益明显；一周线上 A/B 实验进一步验证了其在用户参与、内容消费和长期留存方面的提升。
key_points_zh: 提出 SkillChain，将电商图像 AI 助手的不同用户意图抽象为可演化的 Skill，解决 LLM 在商品搜索、风格推荐、视觉百科、工具调用等模式间混淆的问题。
系统包含三阶段闭环：Skill Creator 负责从任务规范和交互轨迹启动技能，Route Optimizer 负责路由对齐，Body Refiner 通过双路径 LLM-Judge 评估持续优化 Skill Body。
核心价值在于将原本依赖人工维护的意图约束、回复格式和领域知识沉淀为可自动迭代的技能体系，适应电商场景中动态扩展的意图空间。
在生产级电商图像助手部署后，SkillChain 显著提升聚合响应质量，结构合规性和内容质量提升最为突出。
一周线上 A/B 实验显示，该方法不仅改善离线质量指标，也带来用户参与度、内容消费和长期留存的显著增长。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong production-grounded e-commerce agent paper that closes the loop between visual shopping intent routing, skill refinement, and measurable user engagement.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇很强的电商智能体论文，将视觉购物意图路由、技能迭代和线上用户增长紧密结合。
